name: audio-analysis-dedupe
description: Offline audio analysis and duplicate detection for DJ libraries

interface.shortDescription: Inspect audio properties and find duplicate tracks.
interface.longDescription: Dependency-free analysis of WAV, AIFF and AU files with an optional ffprobe fallback. Reports size, duration, sample rate, channels, codec and bitrate, groups exact SHA-256 duplicates, and lists metadata-based near-duplicate candidates with an explicit difference list. It never deletes or modifies a file.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find duplicate tracks in my music folder.
